name: watch FSDI job
command:
while true; do st=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8321/api/jobs | python3 -c "
import json,sys
js = {j['id']: j for j in json.load(sys.stdin)}
j3 = js.get(3,{}).get('state','?')
print(j3)
exit(0 if j3 in ('done','error','cancelled') else 1)"); echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) job3: $st" && exit 0; sleep 60; done
description: watch FSDI shapes job 3 until terminal
